description: This file defines API routes for managing attendees in an event management system using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for registering, listing, and removing attendees, with business rules enforcing unique emails per event, capacity limits, and owner-only removal.

methods.name: Event _get_event_or_404(db: Session, event_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an event by ID or raises a 404 error if not found.

methods.name: add_attendee( event_id: int, payload: AttendeeCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Registers a new attendee to an event, enforcing capacity and email uniqueness.

methods.name: list_attendees( event_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), skip: int = Query(default=0, ge=0), limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100), )
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of attendees for a specific event.

methods.name: remove_attendee( event_id: int, attendee_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Removes an attendee from an event; only the event owner can perform this operation.
